import shutil
import openpyxl
from decimal import Decimal

shutil.copy(INIT, OUT)

vals = openpyxl.load_workbook(INIT, data_only=True)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT)

sheet_name = vals.active.title if vals.active is not None else "Sheet1"
vws = vals[sheet_name]
ws = wb[sheet_name]

def to_text(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "TRUE" if v else "FALSE"
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, float):
        if v.is_integer():
            return str(int(v))
        s = repr(v)
        if "e" in s or "E" in s:
            s = format(Decimal(s), "f")
        return s
    s = str(v).strip()
    return s if s else None

max_row = max(vws.max_row, 269)
written = 0

for r in range(1, max_row + 1):
    v = vws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    t = to_text(v)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2)
    if t is None:
        c.value = None
    else:
        c.value = t
        c.number_format = "@"
        written += 1

wb.save(OUT)

print("sheet:", sheet_name, "max_row:", max_row, "written:", written)

print("B260:", ws.cell(row=260, column=2).value if max_row >= 260 else None)
print("B269:", ws.cell(row=269, column=2).value if max_row >= 269 else None)
